overview: The Medford School Committee approved funding for the elementary science curriculum, accepted donations and school reports, and voted to audit heating issues at Medford High School. The committee also referred proposed member conduct rules to the Committee of the Whole and received updates on facility security and grant applications.

items.title: Medford High School String Orchestra Presentation
items.summary: The Medford High School String Orchestra, led by Tony Zigny, performed holiday music for the committee.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved the minutes of the December 3, 2018 meeting as amended to request a February report on booster group administration.

items.title: Bills, Transfers, and Payrolls
items.summary: Approved routine bills, fund transfers, and payrolls.

items.title: Report of the Secretary
items.summary: Accepted a report highlighting a summer student journalism workshop conducted with the Medford Transcript.

items.title: Buildings and Grounds Subcommittee: Safety and Menstrual Hygiene Dispensers
items.summary: Approved the subcommittee report and authorized installing five free feminine hygiene product dispensers at the high school, requesting further health department guidance regarding tampon provision.

items.title: Rules Subcommittee: School Committee Functions and Conduct
items.summary: Referred a draft document outlining key functions of the school committee and a potential member censure provision to the Committee of the Whole.

items.title: Community Relations Subcommittee
items.summary: Approved scheduling a public school committee meet-and-greet prior to the February Medford Family Network Valentine's Social and placed the November report on file.

items.title: Citywide PTO Disney Vacation Raffle
items.summary: The Citywide PTO concluded its Disney vacation fundraiser, generating over $4,000 for each elementary school and drawing the winning ticket.

items.title: High School Heating System Audit
items.summary: Voted to conduct an immediate audit of heating systems across Medford High School following parent reports of failing units and cold classrooms.

items.title: Superintendent's Report
items.summary: Superintendent Edouard-Vincent reported on school events, noted that Medford was not selected for MSBA core project funding, and previewed an upcoming presentation on youth vaping.

items.title: High School Courtyard Orchard
items.summary: Accepted a presentation from CCSR students detailing the planting of fruit trees and berry bushes in the Medford High School interior courtyard.

items.title: BotBall Robotics Tournament Donation
items.summary: Accepted a $2,000 corporate donation from MeDay Technology to support the Medford High School robotics team in the New England Regional BotBall competition.

items.title: Advanced Placement Honor Roll Recognition
items.summary: Received a report commending Medford High School for its placement on the national AP District Honor Roll.

items.title: FOSS Science Curriculum Approval
items.summary: Approved a revised three-year contract totaling $278,652 to purchase FOSS science curriculum materials and teacher training for elementary schools.

items.title: New Business: MSBA Application Discussion and Condolence Resolution
items.summary: Discussed feedback on the MSBA capital application process and observed a moment of silence for Julie Green, sister of State Representative Christine Barber.
